name: dead-claude-skills
description: deadmade's personal Claude Code setup: own skills plus the third-party plugins used on every machine.

plugins.name: dead-skills
plugins.description: Default bundle: global instructions and personal agents, and pulls in the core plugins of this marketplace as dependencies.

plugins.name: superpowers
plugins.description: Brainstorming, subagent driven development with built in code review, systematic debugging, and red/green TDD.

plugins.name: ponytail
plugins.description: Forces the laziest solution that works. YAGNI, stdlib first, one line over fifty.

plugins.name: nix-lsp
plugins.description: Nix language server (nixd) for code intelligence (requires nixd on PATH)

plugins.name: mcp-basic
plugins.description: Basic MCP servers for every machine: Context7 (up-to-date library docs).

plugins.name: mcp-github
plugins.description: GitHub's hosted MCP server (repos, issues, PRs, Actions). Opt-in per machine.

plugins.name: mcp-azure
plugins.description: Azure DevOps Server MCP server (self-hosted, PAT). Opt-in per machine, configure with /plugin configure.

plugins.name: atlassian
plugins.description: Atlassian's official plugin: Rovo MCP server for Jira and Confluence (OAuth sign-in via /mcp) plus skills. Opt-in.

plugins.name: mattpocock-picks
plugins.description: Curated Matt Pocock skills that complement superpowers: the productivity skills plus grilling with domain docs, spec → tickets and architecture deepening. Opt-in.

plugins.name: pstack-picks
plugins.description: Curated skills from poteto's pstack, rewritten for Claude Code: how/why, adversarial review, unslop, architect/arena, principles. Opt-in.

plugins.name: graphify
plugins.description: Graphify: turn a codebase into a queryable knowledge graph (/graphify). Needs the graphify CLI (uv tool install graphifyy). Opt-in.

plugins.name: dev-feature
plugins.description: /dev-feature: grills you on a feature, has you write the design, then implements against it behind a hook-enforced lock. Opt-in.

plugins.name: hallmark
plugins.description: Hallmark: anti-AI-slop design skill for web frontends, scoped to browser UI work. Vendored from nutlope/hallmark. Opt-in.
